title: Read a member's primary savings balance
description: Signs on to the CoreOne teller console, looks up a member by member number, opens the member record, and returns the current balance of the member's Primary Share (savings) account.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Current balance of the Primary Share account in USD, as a decimal string (e.g. "250.00").
